Senior Full Stack Developer
Bucharest, Romania or remote
 About The Role
 As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will architect and build high-performance, scalable web applications using React and Meteor. You’ll drive best practices across the stack—from data modeling in MongoDB to server-side logic in Node.js. TypeScript as a requirement for most of the applications and services. You’ll also help shape our AI/ML integration in our AI first products, leveraging LLMs, RAG-based memory, and graph/vector databases to power next-generation and leading innovative features. Keeping ontop of current technologies and releases in this fast moving space is a must, and being able to quickly pivot and multitask are a must. Being able to own the whole task and work cross-project is expected of a Sr. level developer. Use of AI coding tools is encouraged.
Key Responsibilities
Feature Development: Lead end-to-end design and implementation of complex features in React and Meteor, python, Node JS, Typescript, and GO, ensuring clean abstractions and modularity. 
Architecture & Patterns: Experience with Meteor client/server architecture, including pub/sub and general familiarity with best practices. 
Data Layer: Model and optimize MongoDB, implement strategies and sanitization, and integrate vector stores or graph databases for semantic search and RAG workflows. Understanding of Milvus and mesh databases preferred. 
AI/ML Integration: Integrations with LLM APIs, embedding pipelines, and RAG memory layers; Understanding local embedders, how tokenization, and chunking works is needed for all sorts of internal and external projects that implement AI first software. 
API & Backend Services: Develop RESTful endpoints and plugins in Node.js/TypeScript, python, GO, and Meteor. 
PRs, Testing & Quality: Be able to implement unit, integration, and UI tests (Jest and custom). Understand linting and participate in PR reviews for the company. 
 Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field 
5+ years full-stack web development experience, with at least 3 years on React and Meteor 
Strong proficiency with MongoDB data modeling, indexing, and aggregation pipelines. Experience with Milvus and graph databases a plus. 
Solid coding skills in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, Python, and Bash, Meteor, and REACT. 
Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, and familiarity with vector or graph databases 
Expertise in browser and IDE debugging workflows (Chrome DevTools, VS Code) 
Comfortable setting up and maintaining Git workflows, branching models, and CI in GitHub Actions or similar 
Proven track record of delivering production-grade features autonomously 
 Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience with AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, EC2) or other cloud platforms 
Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and Kubernetes for dev/test environments 
Understanding of CI/CD best practices and IaC (Terraform, Pulumi)
